newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Port conditions update - Angola - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Angola - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ANGOLA, March 21 - Customs department have gone on strike. All clearance of goods for import and export have been halted. There is no cargo moving in/out of the port of Luanda.

Lobito, Namibe, Soyo and Cabinda are reported to be operating normally. Pilots and towage operations for vessels are currently operating. Vessel delays are anticipated. All offshore crude terminals are operating normally and no berthing delays reported.
